summary: Frontend-only mobile preview smoke tested at 390x844: onboarding, plan build, Today task rendering/tap, all four tabs, settings save, backup controls, and overflow.
action_items: Add stable testID props to onboarding controls, task cards/checkboxes, tab controls, settings inputs/buttons, and confirmation actions for reliable mobile regression automation.
critical_code_review_comments: Interactive components in the reviewed screens generally lack testID props, so the required testID-first automation contract is not met; this is a testability/accessibility regression risk, although visible-label smoke interactions passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL tested at https://doc2app-4.preview.emergentagent.com with 390x844. New browser contexts start onboarding; complete Continue, Continue, Build my plan before tab checks.
rca_of_issue: The first automation run hit a strict locator ambiguity because Today appears both as the screen title and tab label; this was a test-selector issue, not an app failure. A corrected role-based tab run completed successfully. A separate fresh context correctly began onboarding, confirming no persistence defect was established by that run.
